bugs_found: compound_interest formula is wrong: swaps principal/rate, omits exponent, and ignores years in the returned value.
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate fractional years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), changing terms without validation.
transfer is not atomic: source is debited before destination credit, so a later failure can leave balances inconsistent.
transfer does not validate amount/account balances as finite Decimals, allowing type errors or NaN/Infinity edge cases into balance logic.
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min or capped fee exceeds the amount.
fx_convert does not validate FX rate positivity/finite value, so zero, negative, NaN, or Infinity rates can produce invalid converted amounts.
Money outputs are not quantized to currency minor units, so divisions/conversions can silently use Decimal context precision instead of explicit financial rounding.
